title: Hand-Cranked
summary: With the lamp dead and a boat in the dark, Ilsa needs a light that needs no power.

beats.text: Without my beam, the sea was black. Forty people were steering for a rock they could no longer see.
Their little lamp zigzagged. Somewhere ahead of it, the reef waited.
The generator was dead. I found the old lamp's clockwork in the oil store.
A crank, a bottle of paraffin, a mirror. Nothing else would burn.
Something scratched on the tower door. Something patient.
A boy's whisper drifted from the dark. "Don't open it. They hear the latch."
beats.speaker: pip

beats.text: Pip, eleven, had been hiding in the oil store for three days. He knew the crank.
We turned it together, arms burning. The old lamp caught, swung and lit the water.
Far out, the boat turned toward us. Then, behind the dunes, three flashes answered my light.
